text: ok so then if that doesnt work then how does this ? [Image #6]
resolution: Answered the user's screenshot showing textured wall posters working in the compiled game while a painted cooked prop is gray. The posters are FacePainter decal/material images that decode in the Zig loader (gpu/decal_raster.zig stbi_load_from_memory; the game host links stb_image via framework/c.zig). Cooked-prop paint takes a different path (MESH_PROPS lump, decoded at BAKE time under v8cli, which lacks the image-codec door) so it ships textureless. The two are not contradictory: load-time decode works, bake-time decode does not. Fix (folds into req_1544): ship the cooked-prop paint PNG bytes through MESH_PROPS as passthrough and decode in the loader with stbi, mirroring the decal path; this also avoids rebuilding the shared v8cli binary.
